name: CIVIC RISK INDEX: District Outcome Prediction Market S2
subcategory: prediction market — civic and political outcomes
description: A gray-market prediction exchange operated through a distributed BCI-relay network with no registered corporate parent, allowing users to bet on district-level political outcomes, civil enforcement actions, infrastructure failure timelines, and crime statistic movements across Meridian 88's forty-one registered districts. Season Two expanded the board to include corponation charter renewal odds and Sable Charter amendment probability pools, drawing unprecedented Tier 3 and Tier 4 participation. Settlement is handled in anonymous Quanta escrow wallets, and the platform's legal status varies dramatically depending on which district's enforcement jurisdiction a given bet falls under.
story_hooks: A runner discovers their neighborhood's infrastructure failure has been bet on with alarming specificity three weeks before the pipes actually burst — someone knew.
A Tier 4 political analyst moonlights as a high-volume Civic Risk trader and is recruited by a corponation to manipulate the market as a disinformation tool.
A Tier 2 schoolteacher wins a life-changing sum on a ward-level enforcement outcome and is immediately targeted by the people who lost the bet.
